name: filesystem
title: File System
description: Reads, writes and searches files inside the folders you specify. Folders you don't specify are left alone.

args.prompt: Absolute path of the folder the server may use

name: github
title: GitHub
description: GitHub's official remote MCP server. Works with repositories, issues and pull requests. Requires a GitHub personal access token.

name: playwright
title: Playwright (Browser Automation)
description: Launches a browser and operates it: opens pages, clicks and types.
note: The browser's own traffic may ignore the proxy environment variables, and then the network allowlist does not control it.

name: fetch
title: Fetch (Web Page Retrieval)
description: Fetches the web page at a given URL and passes it on as Markdown.
note: The hosts of the sites to fetch also have to be added to the network allowlist.

name: memory
title: Memory (Knowledge Graph)
description: Saves what should be remembered across conversations to a file, as a knowledge graph.

env.name: MEMORY_FILE_PATH
env.prompt: Absolute path of the file to store the memory in
